rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Re-verified against current text. Every pronoun/demonstrative traces to an in-chunk or earlier-chunk named antecedent. Closest-to-violating: chunk 5 line 62 "Amp changed its mind about the whole mechanism" — 'the whole mechanism' resolves to Handoff, named earlier in the same paragraph ('The Handoff reversal is the clearest demonstration'). Chunk 8 line 128 "The dispatcher pattern scales cross-repo" — resolves to the 'CLAUDE.md routing' bullet a few lines earlier in the same chunk. No forward-pointing or never-named referent found.

No chunk points at another file by position. Chunk 6 line 88 "the moves listed above" is a within-file sequential callback (permitted by rule 1/2) to the same chunk's own bullet list and carries a maintainer accept-note at line 149 for the related §12 concern. External docs named by title, never located by page position (chunk 2 line 24; chunk 8 line 133).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -niE "guess|predict" over the body → 0 matches. No guess-before-reveal structure exists in this file.
Every chunk (1-9) carries a self-sufficient claim. Closest-to-thin: chunk 1 (lines 5-14), three short numbered rules, but each states a complete point, not a bare wait-state fragment.

Every header names what its chunk delivers, e.g. chunk 5 header (line 54) previews the two artefacts (Feedback Loopable, Handoff) the chunk covers; chunk 9 header (line 135) previews the three filters that follow. No header contradicted by its chunk.

grep -n "Not .*\. Not .*\." over the body → 0 matches. No anaphora/epistrophe triples. grep -niE 'one of the (most|best)|most (important|useful|valuable)' → one hit at line 81 'The single tip Cherny names as most important' — attributes the superlative to Cherny's own naming of his own tip, not a self-grading claim about this curriculum's value, so it is not the banned value-prop leak. No number+own-retraction, no abstraction-noun stacks, no empty-leg verb triplets found.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Chunk 1 (lines 9, 11, 13) re-checked: the three bolded leads are now short handles ('One published framework.', 'The map is partial.', 'Quote with care.' — 3-4 words each), within the ≲5-word handle cap; that instance of the finding is resolved. Chunk 8 (lines 117-126) is unchanged: seven bolded bullet leads on one `##` slide (**A single orchestrator**, **Phase-organised skill catalogue.**, **Seven design principles**, **Front-loaded read-only analysis.**, **Mandatory gates fire positionally**, **Re-invocation as control flow.**, **CLAUDE.md as half the system.**). None is a §34 task-sizing callout or a module-template LO bullet (the rule's two named exceptions); this is a narrative case-study slide, not a reading-list/menu or lookup surface, so the ≤1-per-slide budget waiver does not apply either. Each individual span is within the handle-length cap, but the per-slide COUNT (7) is the pre-2026-07-09 monoculture the rule bans. Confirmed still an open, unactioned finding per orchestrator instruction.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Keep bold on the 1-2 handles the slide most needs (e.g. 'A single orchestrator', 'Seven design principles') and flatten the remaining five bullet leads to plain prose.
